name: Entangled Hearts
source:
Prince Cas had his work cut out for him- cursed by a dragon whilst still in his Mother's womb, he is fated to suffer excruciating pain and nightmares come nightfall. Once he turns eighteen, he sets off in search of a cure before the curse can spread to his heart. Only,  there aren't many leads at all since the dragons have long been exiled to the cold and desolate regions of the North.

On the way, he encounters Damian, a no-nonsense mercenary who would be on his side as long as he's paid one gold a day and a little fairy that communicates exclusively in soft buzzes. Play as Cas as he adventures onwards. 

Learn more about his people, his travel companions and most importantly about Cas himself. Will he be able to cure his predicament or die a premature death as foretold by the elders?

[From [url=https://sayumi101.itch.io/entangled-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Cas王子的处境十分艰难。他尚在母亲腹中时便遭到巨龙诅咒，注定每到夜幕降临，就要承受剧痛与噩梦。年满18岁后，他踏上寻找解咒之法的旅程，希望赶在诅咒蔓延到心脏之前得救。然而，巨龙早已被放逐到北方寒冷荒凉的地带，能够追寻的线索寥寥无几。

途中，他遇见了务实干练的佣兵Damian，只要每天付一枚金币，对方就会站在他这边；还遇见了一只只用轻柔嗡鸣交流的小妖精。扮演Cas，继续这段冒险。

了解他的人民、旅伴，更重要的是，了解Cas自己。他能摆脱困境，还是会像长老们预言的那样英年早逝？

[摘自[url=https://sayumi101.itch.io/entangled-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
